data.explanation: This is a bill from an electrician for work done in your home. You need to transfer the total amount, €1,214.99, to the IBAN shown by the deadline shown (14 days after the invoice date). If you don't pay in time, the company could send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are mentioned here. Keep this invoice for your tax return, as craftsman/household service costs (§35a EStG) can often be partly deducted from your German income tax.
data.tax_note: Labour costs for craftsman services performed in the home (Handwerkerleistungen) can usually be partly claimed as a tax reduction under §35a EStG; keep this invoice and pay by bank transfer (cash payments are not deductible).
